briefing: This is {PATRON}. I run things here at {HERE}, and I have a packet that has to move fast.
Take it to the station one jump out. Do not ask what is inside, and do not ask about the paperwork. Just get it there before anyone notices it moved.
dossier.lead: {PATRON} sent word from {WORLD} and wants a moment of the commander's time.

run.arrive: Dock at {TARGET} and hand off the packet for {PAY}
run.success: The packet reached {TARGET} in time, {PAY} is banked

rumour.far: Traders say {PATRON} on {WORLD} pays well for a quiet delivery.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word from {WORLD} that the packet is ready and waiting.

dossier.news: Work waits at {WORLD}, where {PATRON} needs a packet moved without delay.

story.opening: The commander picked up a sealed packet at {WORLD} on day {DAY}.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the packet had reached its destination, and the job was done.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the packet never arrived, and the deal fell through.

run.success: On day {DAY}, the packet reached {WORLD} without incident.
run.failed: On day {DAY}, the packet failed to reach {WORLD} in time.

dossier.title: The Sealed Packet Run
